text: Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
bibleVerseText: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

text: I come to God's throne of grace with confidence because Jesus made me welcome.
bibleVerseText: Let us then approach God's throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

text: My faith is the substance of what I hope for and the proof of what I cannot see.
bibleVerseText: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see. This is what the ancients were commended for.

text: I run my race with endurance, fixing my eyes on Jesus and throwing off every weight.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

text: God's Word is alive, active, and sharper than any two-edged sword.
bibleVerseText: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword.

text: Jesus is the anchor of my soul — firm and secure through every storm.
bibleVerseText: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

text: God gives me wisdom freely when I ask in faith — without conditions and without finding fault.
bibleVerseText: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

text: God uses every trial I face to perfect and refine my faith.
bibleVerseText: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

text: God blesses me when I persevere — I do not give up under pressure.
bibleVerseText: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial because, having stood the test, that person will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.

text: I submit to God, I resist the devil.
bibleVerseText: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

text: I draw near to God and He draws near to me.
bibleVerseText: Come near to God and he will come near to you.

text: My prayer of faith moves God — He heals the sick and raises them up.
bibleVerseText: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up.

text: I am chosen, holy, and beloved — not by my record but by His grace.
bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession.

text: I have a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
bibleVerseText: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope.

text: By the wounds of Jesus I am completely healed.
bibleVerseText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

text: I cast every anxiety on God because He cares for me.
bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

text: I walk in humility and God pours abundant grace on me.
bibleVerseText: God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.

text: My inheritance is imperishable and unfading, kept in heaven for me by the power of God.
bibleVerseText: And into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you.

text: I participate in the divine nature through His exceeding great promises.
bibleVerseText: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature.

text: God has given me everything I need for life and godliness.
bibleVerseText: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him.

text: My calling and election are secure — God has confirmed my place in His kingdom.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble, and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

text: I grow in grace and in the knowledge of my Lord Jesus Christ.
bibleVerseText: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

text: God's timing is not my timing — one day with Him is as a thousand years.
bibleVerseText: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

text: God chose me on purpose, with love and a plan, before I was ever born.
bibleVerseText: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you.

text: God gives me joy that does not depend on my circumstances — I rejoice always.
bibleVerseText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

text: God sanctifies me completely in spirit, soul, and body and keeps me blameless.
bibleVerseText: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through.

text: I am a child of light and a child of the day.
bibleVerseText: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief. You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

text: Christ is coming again, and I live every day in that glorious expectation.
bibleVerseText: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

text: God is faithful — He strengthens me and guards me from every evil attack.
bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

text: God establishes me firm in His truth and I am not tossed by every wind.
bibleVerseText: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

text: My heart is encouraged and established in every good word and work.
bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

text: The Lord directs my heart into His love and the steadfastness of Christ.
bibleVerseText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's perseverance.

text: The grace and peace of God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ rest upon me always.
bibleVerseText: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

text: I don't second-guess what God has called me to — He is faithful and He will see it through.
bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

text: God is working in me to will and do His purpose — I walk in every room He opens.
bibleVerseText: For it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill his good purpose.

text: Fear of what people think no longer has power over me — I live for God's approval alone.
bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

text: God has commanded me to be strong and courageous — His presence is all the readiness I need.
bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

text: I was made to stand out for His glory, not to blend in.
bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

text: The Spirit in me is greater than anything I face — so I speak up boldly.
bibleVerseText: The one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

text: I am not disqualified by my history — every person God ever used was broken before they were bold.
bibleVerseText: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

text: My confidence doesn't come from having all the answers — it comes from knowing the One who does.
bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

text: The same God who parted the sea walks before me into every unknown.
bibleVerseText: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

text: I carry a quiet, unshakeable boldness that only comes from time spent with God — and it shows.
bibleVerseText: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
